title: leggedrobotics/pace-sim2real
summary: PACE targets sim-to-real transfer for legged robots by systematically identifying actuator and joint dynamics using only standard joint encoders, rather than relying on specialized sensing or hand-tuned modeling. The repo is useful for making simulated legged-robot behavior better match hardware, especially where unmodeled drivetrain and joint effects are a major source of transfer failure.

extra.full_text: PACE: A systematic approach for sim-to-real transfer of legged robots, identifying actuator and joint dynamics with standard joint encoders.

title: google-deepmind/mujoco_playground
summary: MuJoCo Playground is an open-source library for training robot policies with GPU-accelerated simulation and carrying them toward sim-to-real deployment. It is useful as infrastructure for robot learning experiments where fast MuJoCo rollouts, scalable reinforcement learning, and transfer-oriented workflows matter more than hand-building the simulation stack from scratch.

extra.full_text: An open-source library for GPU-accelerated robot learning and sim-to-real transfer.

title: NVIDIA/warp
summary: NVIDIA Warp is a Python framework for writing GPU-accelerated simulation and compute kernels, aimed at robotics, physics simulation, and machine learning workflows. It is useful when researchers want CUDA-level performance from Python while building differentiable simulations, robot environments, or custom high-performance operators without dropping fully into low-level GPU code.

extra.full_text: A Python framework for GPU-accelerated simulation, robotics, and machine learning.

title: isaac-sim/IsaacLab-Arena
summary: IsaacLab-Arena extends NVIDIA Isaac Lab with a composable simulation layer for building robot-learning environments from interchangeable robots, objects, task setups, and scene configurations. It is aimed at quickly prototyping and scaling policy evaluation across diverse embodiments and environments, making it useful for testing whether learned robotic behaviors generalize beyond a single hand-crafted simulator setup.

extra.full_text: Isaac Lab - Arena is a robotics simulation framework that enhances NVIDIA Isaac Lab by providing a composable, scalable system for creating diverse simulation environments and evaluating robot learning policies. The framework enables developers to rapidly prototype and test robotic tasks with various robot embodiments, objects, and environments.

title: iit-DLSLab/basic-locomotion-isaaclab
summary: An IsaacLab DirectEnv implementation for basic quadruped locomotion, aimed at training and testing policies across multiple robot platforms. It is useful as a starting point for legged-robot experiments because it includes the surrounding pipeline pieces researchers usually need: simulation-to-simulation transfer and paths toward sim-to-real deployment.

extra.full_text: An IsaacLab DirectEnv for basic quadrupedal locomotion tasks, with support for multiple quadruped robots, sim-to-sim, and sim-to-real pipelines

title: iit-DLSLab/sim2real-robot-identification
summary: Provides joint calibration routines for quadrupeds and manipulators aimed at reducing the mismatch between simulated and real robot kinematics. It is meant to make policies or controllers developed in Isaac Lab or MuJoCo transfer more reliably onto physical robots by identifying and correcting joint-level discrepancies before deployment.

extra.full_text: A joints calibration routine for quadrupeds and manipulators to facilitate sim-to-real transfer from isaaclab and mujoco to real robots

title: RobotControlStack/robot-control-stack
summary: RobotControlStack is a lightweight sim-to-real stack for training and deploying Vision-Language-Action models and reinforcement-learning agents without depending on ROS. It provides native MuJoCo Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution across several robot platforms, including Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101, and YAM, making it useful for teams that want a tighter, simpler path from simulation experiments to real robot control.

extra.full_text: A lean, ROS-free sim-to-real framework for training and deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and RL agents. Native MuJoCo Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution for Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101 and YAM.

title: ROBOTIS-GIT/cyclo_lab

It is aimed at the practical path from simulated training to real robot deployment, with Sim2Real support for moving learned policies onto physical hardware.

summary: menloresearch/isaac_asimov is the official reinforcement-learning training framework for Asimov humanoid robots, built on NVIDIA Isaac Lab. It is meant for training and experimenting with humanoid robot policies in simulation, giving researchers a concrete Isaac Lab-based starting point for Asimov-specific locomotion or control work.

title: facebookresearch/project_superdex
summary: SuperDex is a unified robotics simulation platform from Meta that combines a purpose-built physics engine, authoring tools, and a scalable reinforcement learning interface. It is aimed at dexterous robot learning workflows where researchers need fast simulation, controllable task setup, and VR-based teleoperation in one place, with more capabilities planned beyond the current release.

extra.full_text: SuperDex brings together a purpose-built physics engine, robotics authoring tools, and a scalable reinforcement learning interface in a unified simulation platform, with VR-based teleoperation and additional capabilities planned for future releases.

title: iit-DLSLab/fault-locomotion-isaaclab
